research_notes: Follow-up: establish pre-2006 jobs and complete study dates; seek Fifield and VECCI dated position records and IPA 2011/2016 appointment/departure records for hours, leave and role transitions. Date fellowships and patronage and determine whether paid, without assuming executive titles prove full-time work.

Reviewed 2026-09-29: APH, own biography, IPA annual report staff/institutional pages, public secondary promotion chronology. Targeted first-job and employer searches did not establish additional jobs or full-time terms; unrelated sports coaches and writers excluded.

The IPA report directly describes a nonprofit financed by voluntary contributions; its free-market advocacy is not a reason to code employment as private enterprise. Employer association and political-staff exclusions are also applied consistently.
No numerical years computed; unknown career coverage is not zero. Year-level boundary overlaps retained. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record remains unresolved.

2026-10-02 follow-up found contemporary US Congressional Record and programme brochure substantiating previously omitted2008 unpaid full-time internship. Added VECCI writer and Fifield special adviser titles from existing secondary biography and contemporary2013 IPA editor byline. Targeted IPA appointment/annual report and first-job/hour searches yielded no other qualifying paid work or complete chronology. Unrelated rugby player, UK economist and TV archivist excluded. Next: resolve2008 break in Fifield employment, VECCI appointment terms, IPA promotion/leave records and pre2006 jobs. Intern programme months are described in evidence, not invented personal endpoints. All added roles excluded; no zero headline inferred.

2026-10-03 follow-up adds three omitted official party/student-political offices: University of Melbourne Liberal Club vice-president2008, Australian Liberal Students' Federation vice-president2008–2009 and Victorian Young Liberals president2009. They are retained as overlapping party activity and excluded without assuming pay or workload. A contemporaneous ABC biography observes University of Melbourne student status and former Liberal-staffer status on15September2010, but does not establish study or Fifield exact boundaries. IPA primary material observes his writing byDecember2011, editorship byDecember2012, development/communications directorship in2014 and deputy title by2014–2016; it still does not resolve exact appointment/departure days, hours or leave. VECCI appointment terms and pre2006 jobs remain unresolved; no headline zero inferred.

2026-10-04 follow-up: targeted IPA-domain searches surfaced a 25 January 2016 employer media release and an October 2016 submission naming Paterson as deputy executive director. These corroborate the already recorded 2014–2016 deputy-role envelope but do not narrow the 2011 appointment, March2016 Senate transition, hours or leave. No new VECCI appointment terms, Fifield break evidence or pre-2006 employment surfaced. Generic employer-domain search is exhausted for this pass; IPA/VECCI personnel files and Fifield office records remain decisive. No substantive fact changed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Programme records resolve previously undated leadership study: McKinnon2022 report identifies Paterson’s2022 course, and2023 report places supported Harvard security executive study in late2023. Split the old grouped study spell. Newly added2023 Asia fellowship directly listed by International Strategy Forum and S R Nathan exchange corroborated by Singapore MFA; announced17–20January2023 itinerary is expressly planned, not proven work boundaries. Fellowships and professional development excluded; no salaries or FTE inferred. Fifield/VECCI/IPA employment hours, leave and pre2006 coverage remain outstanding.

2026-10-05 employer archive follow-up: navigated original IPA author page https://ipa.org.au/author/jamespaterson to https://ipa.org.au/annual-reports . Visible report index lists2020–2025, not2016; author archive shows already-known late2015/January2016 work. Candidate2016 report paths inaccessible via web reader; no assumed document content. Broad search returned unrelated UK advertising IPA, poverty-action IPA and Patterson/football namesakes; discarded and narrowed to correct employer domain. No original2016 departure/leave, VECCI appointment,2008 Fifield break or pre2006 paid-work evidence recovered. Retain original2016 IPA staff/appointment archive and individual earlier-employment evidence as gaps; no new facts or total calculated.

Second targeted follow-up2026-10-05: own biography revealed previously omitted Adam Smith Institute report authorship; followed publisher research page to original A Ripper Deal PDF, confirming named author and August2020 preface. Explicit authorship spell retains unknown commissioning/payment/work boundaries and hours, with no publisher-as-employer assumption. Own timeline heading2019 conflicts with paragraph2020; original report resolves publication context to2020. IPA2011 joining,2014 promotion,2016 departure and VECCI appointment searches returned known chronology and derivative bios; one engine produced unrelated date/year pages, discarded and recovered using other engine. Original report has no additional earlier jobs. IPA/VECCI personnel and2008 Fifield leave still decisive; no years calculated.
